class.name: SuperposSpawnEntry
class.brief_description: Local Inspector authoring of one admitted spawn resource.
class.description: Maps one registered schema to a trusted local [PackedScene] and at most 64 field projections. Network input selects only this numeric resource ID; it never supplies a scene path, script, method or property name. Full-width unsigned identifiers use signed opaque Variant bits in GDScript and unsigned native metadata in generated C# and C++ bindings.

members.member: Maps nonzero field IDs to a Dictionary containing exactly [code]node[/code] (a relative [NodePath] inside the instantiated scene, the empty path for its root, without [code]..[/code] or subnames) and [code]property[/code] (a [StringName] of at most 64 characters). Duplicate IDs or duplicate targets fail admission.
Nonzero unsigned resource identifier admitted by the receiver. It must be unique within its catalog.
Trusted local scene. Admission copies its native scene structure without instantiating it or running scripts. Nested referenced assets remain trusted engine resources.
Nonzero unsigned schema identifier. It must name a schema configured on the receiving [SuperposSession] and be unique within its catalog.
